best_for: Fixed-rate personal loans with origination fees deducted from the proceeds.

checked_profile.summary: Fixed-rate personal loans with origination fees deducted from the proceeds.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Amounts and terms
facts.text: $2,000–$50,000, generally 36–60 months. Higher minimums apply in Massachusetts, Ohio and Georgia. Products are unavailable in certain states and territories.

facts.label: APR
facts.text: Advertised APR is 6.99%–35.99%, depending on creditworthiness and other application factors.

facts.label: Origination fee
facts.text: 0.99%–9.99% is deducted from the loan proceeds. Terms of four years or longer have an origination fee of at least 4.99%.

facts.label: Credit and repayment
facts.text: The initial rate check does not affect your credit score; accepting an approved offer triggers a hard inquiry. Loans can be prepaid without penalty.
